rejectedProductHypothesis: Increasing the checkpoint assistant meta spacer from 26px to 30px made the assistant row height exactly match Web at 151.75px.
The change did not improve transcript SSIM and slightly reduced full-frame SSIM from 0.917882 to 0.917871.
The experiment was fully reverted and is not attributed as a product improvement.
